name: Sea
overview: The Bible reveals that God created the seas by gathering the waters together, calling the dry land Earth and the waters Seas, affirming His sovereign design and goodness in creation. He established boundaries for the waters, setting limits that they cannot cross, demonstrating His control over the natural order. Furthermore, God granted mankind dominion over the fish of the sea, highlighting humanity's appointed stewardship under His authority. These truths emphasize God's power and intentionality in forming and governing the seas.
